verdict.rationale: cubic documents a CLI that "reviews local changes before you push," finds bugs, and generates a fix prompt for your coding agent. It also documents setup inside Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI, along with an MCP server and skills that bring review findings into the editor workflow. Missing for 10: evidence that the local review matches the PR review (the CLI recommends connecting Codex/Claude Code for more capable models, which suggests the engines may differ), a native in-editor extension with inline diagnostics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
